metrics.name: Payer-feed claim denial rate (current claim versions)
metrics.internal_reason: Denial rate over the payer claim feed: one current version per service (frequency-7 replacements supersede originals, voids end them) and CARC 18 exact-duplicate submissions excluded, the claims-version convention payers and CCLF users apply; Agere convention stated in full.
metrics.summary: Percent of payer-feed medical claims with service_from in the period whose final adjudication is a denial (denied or denied_upheld), counting only the current, non-duplicate version of each claim (payer_claim.counts_in_metrics = 1): replaced originals, voids and CARC 18 duplicate submissions never count.

population.summary: Payer-feed medical claims with service_from in the period.

numerator.summary: Of those, claims whose final_status is denied or denied_upheld.

checks.why: replacement claims supersede their originals, voids end them and CARC 18 duplicate submissions are not claims; count only payer_claim.counts_in_metrics = 1

metrics.sql_template: SELECT 100.0 * sum(final_status IN ('denied','denied_upheld')) / count(*) AS payer_claim_denial_rate FROM payer_claim WHERE counts_in_metrics = 1 AND service_from BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Payer-feed allowed cost per member per month (enrollment months)
metrics.internal_reason: PMPM over the payer feed: allowed dollars on the current version of each paid medical claim plus paid, unreversed pharmacy claims, over member months from enrollment spans (ACO REACH/MSSP expenditure convention without risk adjustment or completion).
metrics.summary: Allowed dollars on payer-feed medical claims (current version, final status paid; replaced, voided and CARC 18 duplicate claims excluded) plus allowed dollars on paid pharmacy claims not reversed by a B2 return to stock, with service/fill dates in the period, divided by member months from enrollment spans in the period.

population.summary: Members with enrollment-span member months in the period.

denominator.summary: member_month rows with month in the period.

numerator.summary: Allowed dollars: payer_claim (counts_in_metrics = 1, final_status paid) + payer_pharmacy_claim (counts_as_fill = 1).

checks.why: only the current, non-duplicate version of each medical claim is spend (payer_claim.counts_in_metrics = 1)
pharmacy claims reversed by a B2 return to stock were never picked up and are not spend (payer_pharmacy_claim.counts_as_fill = 1)

metrics.sql_template: SELECT ((SELECT coalesce(sum(allowed_cents), 0) FROM payer_claim WHERE counts_in_metrics = 1 AND final_status = 'paid' AND service_from BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') + (SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(plan_paid_cents, 0) + coalesce(patient_pay_cents, 0)), 0) FROM payer_pharmacy_claim WHERE counts_as_fill = 1 AND fill_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}')) / 100.0 / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM member_month WHERE month BETWEEN substr('{period_start}', 1, 7) AND substr('{period_end}', 1, 7)), 0) AS payer_allowed_pmpm

metrics.name: ED visits per 1,000 member-years, all sources (EHR, ADT, payer claims)
metrics.summary: ED visits from every source (EHR encounters, ADT registrations, payer claims with POS 23 or revenue 045x/0981; one per real visit, utilization_event) in the period per 1,000 member-years from enrollment-span member months; claims-only members have no EHR encounter, so visit-table counts miss them.

population.summary: Members with enrollment-span member months in the period.

denominator.summary: member_month rows in the period / 12, divided by 1,000.

numerator.summary: utilization_event rows with kind ed_visit dated in the period (one per real visit across sources).

checks.why: ED visits of claims-only members exist only in ADT and payer claims; utilization_event merges every source into one row per visit

metrics.sql_template: SELECT 1000.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind = 'ed_visit' AND event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM member_month WHERE month BETWEEN substr('{period_start}', 1, 7) AND substr('{period_end}', 1, 7)) / 12.0, 0) AS ed_per_1000_member_years
